# Home Maintenance Checklist

Taking care of your property is an important part of being a homeowner. Keeping up with maintenance will help you preserve the condition of your home and help retain its value. Use this checklist to manage monthly and seasonal maintenance tasks.

## Monthly Maintenance
- ☐ Clean furnace filter and remove dust buildup.
- ☐ Check water softener and replenish if needed.
- ☐ Inspect and unclog tub and sink drains.
- ☐ Test smoke alarms, carbon monoxide detectors and fire extinguishers. Change batteries if needed.
- ☐ Check ground-fault circuit interrupters (GFCI outlets).
- ☐ Vacuum heat registers and heat vents and ensure no indoor or outdoor vents are blocked.
- ☐ Flush out hot water from hot water heater.
- ☐ Clean stove hood, burners and grease traps.
- ☐ Clean dryer vents.

## Spring/Summer Seasonal Maintenance
- ☐ Service cooling systems and replace filters.
- ☐ Clean gutter and downspouts. Seal any leaks in gutter seams.
- ☐ Inspect roof for issues (e.g., buckling, damaged/missing shingles) and clear debris.
- ☐ Check foundation, driveway, sidewalks and walkways for cracks.
- ☐ Inspect attic, roof and eaves for water damage and proper ventilation.
- ☐ Inspect basement for dampness and seal appropriately.
- ☐ Check for plumbing leaks, and replace leaky seals/washers if needed.
- ☐ Inspect exterior for peeling paint or dry-rotted caulk.
- ☐ Check windows/doors for dry-rotted weather stripping. Replace if needed.
- ☐ Replace any faulty seals on refrigerator and clean coils.

## Fall/Winter Seasonal Maintenance
- ☐ Check insulation and replace if needed.
- ☐ Drain and turn off exterior faucets/spigots.
- ☐ Inspect sump pump for debris, rust or erosion.
- ☐ Inspect exterior for wasp nests and termites/wood rot.
- ☐ Clean fireplace.
- ☐ Hire professional to clean chimney/flue.
- ☐ Clean humidifier.
